AvMed Entrust Gold 125 (2026)

Carrier: AvMed. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

27 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 22 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document AVMED_AVMED_ENTRUST_GOLD_125 (schema version 1.1.0).

extension.valueString: CMS Health Insurance Exchange Public Use Files, plan year 2026: Plan Attributes PUF (plan-attributes-puf.csv, from https://download.cms.gov/marketplace-puf/2026/plan-attributes-puf.zip) and Benefits and Cost Sharing PUF (benefits-and-cost-sharing-puf.csv, from https://download.cms.gov/marketplace-puf/2026/benefits-and-cost-sharing-puf.zip), downloaded 2026-10-05. HIOS plan ID 19898FL0340001-01 (the Benefit Plan Standard v1.1.0 schema has no identifier field, so the ID is recorded here). extension.valueString: Supplementing with the federal definition of habilitative services: Health care services that help a person keep, learn, or improve skills and functioning for daily living. Examples include therapy for a child who is not walking or talking at the expected age. These services may include physical and occupational therapy, speech-language pathology and other services for people with disabilities in a variety of inpatient and/or outpatient settings.
